spec: 2 mm Dyneema loop or 2.5 mm cable tie, seated in the circumferential groove
notes: DECISION #9: must float AND be tethered. The groove puts the load into the shell as hoop stress; there is no moulded eye to snap.

spec: Cyanoacrylate impregnation, epoxy wash or vapour smoothing
notes: MJF/SLS PA12 is POROUS as printed and will wick. Unsealed it is not a waterproof part. Sealing also adds ~0.2-0.4 g - budget it against the buoyancy margin.
